about.label: THE STORY OF TABUNY
about.title: Crafted with Passion.
about.subtitle: Rooted in Tradition.
about.description: At Tabuny, we believe that great food brings people together. Our mission is to preserve the art of traditional bread-making and deliver the highest quality to every home and business.
about.feature1Desc: We combine centuries-old baking techniques with modern standards.
about.feature3Desc: Punctuality, quality and partnership in every delivery.
about.promise: Every bread that leaves our bakery is the result of passion, patience and love for detail.
about.checkItem1: Crispy on the outside, tender inside.
about.checkItem3: Made from the finest regional ingredients.
about.value1Desc: We use only premium raw materials. We know where they come from and what's in them.
about.value2Desc: Good bread needs rest. We give our dough the time it needs to develop its full aroma.
about.value3Desc: From selecting our regional partners to efficient logistics – we act responsibly toward our environment.
about.value4Desc: We combine centuries-old baking techniques with modern standards for authentic taste.
about.value5Desc: Whether a private celebration or a gastronomy partner – we stand for punctuality and partnership.
about.value6Desc: Delivered safely and reliably by our Swiss company to the highest quality standards. That's our promise with every delivery.
about.promiseText: We are proud to be part of your moment of enjoyment.
about.promiseText2: Tabuny bread is now enjoyed well beyond Swiss borders. Our traditionally crafted specialties are already successfully distributed in Germany, Luxembourg, France, the Netherlands and Austria.
about.storyText1: At Tabuny, we follow no trend, but a conviction. We believe that outstanding bread comes from three things: time, the finest ingredients, and respect for the craft.
about.storyText2: Our Tabuny is more than just bread. It is a piece of history, shaped by hand with love and patience. Like our ancestors, we bake it traditionally over an open fire in a clay oven.
